result.summary: The page is generally polished and visually consistent. The main potential issue is horizontal content clipping in the category and restaurant carousels, though this may be intentional for swipeable sections.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped at the right edge, with only part of another chip visible. The restaurant carousel also cuts off the third card and its title.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousels have clear swipe affordances and appropriate right-side spacing, or show complete items within the viewport if horizontal scrolling is not intended.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower popular restaurant card, obscuring part of its image and potentially its content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page so cards can be fully scrolled above the fixed navigation bar.
